paragraphs.text: Barbar is the large wooded peninsula in the southwest of South Aerona on Dominaria . It lies directly south of Kush and the Green Lands , and north of La. It is inhabited by sapient, carnivorous apes . The wizard Dacian hired the red soldiers, including Tomas , Varrius , and Neith , from Barbar.
